name: Adult Animated Sitcom
traits: simplified characters with uniform outlines, big eyes and small pupils
flat colour with almost no shading
ordinary settings: kitchens, living rooms, offices, cars
bestFor: products used at home or work
suits: groceries, household and personal-care products, apps, subscriptions, delivery; brands with a self-aware, deadpan voice
stylePara: Prime-time animated sitcom look: simplified characters with uniform medium-weight black outlines, rounded heads, large white eyes with small dot pupils, overbite or simple line mouths, four-finger hands; flat cel colour with no shading except a rare single shadow tone; everyday suburban settings drawn with clean straight lines and slightly simplified perspective, a believable lived-in clutter of plain objects; bright, even, slightly saturated television colours; backgrounds outlined in a thinner line than the characters; it looks like a clean digital-ink television production.

rendering.line: uniform medium black line on characters, thinner lighter line on backgrounds; no pressure taper
rendering.shading: flat, no shading; at most one shadow tone under chins and furniture for night or drama
rendering.colour: bright, even TV colours; skin tones in simple flat hues; each character in one fixed outfit palette; product colours exact
rendering.texture: none: clean digital fills, no grain
rendering.lighting: even, high-key interior light; time of day shown by window colour only

motion: Limited TV animation on twos: characters mostly stand and talk with blinks, head tilts and small hand gestures, mouths cycling through a few shapes; actions are quick pose changes; comedic beats land on a held deadpan stare of one to two seconds.
camera: Sitcom coverage: eye-level medium two-shots, over-the-shoulder singles, a wide establishing shot of the room; straight cuts, rare slow push-ins for a punchline; no handheld, no dramatic angles.
avoid: realistic eyes with irises and lashes
dramatic low angles and lens flares
readable posters, cereal boxes or signs generated in the background
sheets: Each character sheet shows front, three-quarter and side in the exact outline weight and flat colours, plus a mouth chart of five shapes and two expressions (deadpan, alarmed); places are wide and reverse views of the room with the clutter fixed; the product is drawn flat with its exact silhouette and colours.
risk: Background clutter fills with fake labels and readable gibberish; ask for plain unlabeled objects. Seedance animates these characters too smoothly and gives them too much acting; specify small gestures and held stares. Small-pupil eyes can grow irises between shots, so send the sheet with every shot.

example.prompt: Prime-time animated sitcom still: a simplified woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top, uniform black outlines, big white eyes with small dot pupils and a deadpan expression, holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap at chest height; an ordinary sunny suburban kitchen drawn in thinner lines with plain unlabeled jars, a fridge and a sink, a droopy fern on the windowsill; flat bright TV colours, no shading, eye-level medium shot. Vertical 9:16. No text.
